components.title: Specification(s) for excipients
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Opening narrative stating all excipients are compendial and tested per pharmacopoeial monographs. CONTRACT: Use exact source wording. PRESENTATION: Plain text string.

components.title: List of excipients with specifications
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Table listing all excipients and their pharmacopoeial standards. CONTRACT: Columns = SR. NO. | Ingredient | Specification. One row per excipient. PRESENTATION: content with columns and rows.

components.title: Abbreviations
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Expansions for pharmacopoeial abbreviations used (e.g. BP, IH, USP).
